crc: Participant-facing study conduct: visits, scanner day, consenting, testing, reimbursement, IRB paperwork.
data-rc: Data management: governance, standardization and integration, the data side of collection, analytics basics.
pipeline: Keeps the processing chain, uploads, archives and servers running.
analyst: Runs analyses: compute environments, software, de-identified data access, the analysis pipelines.
pi-manager: Approvals, onboarding and offboarding, IRB, reporting, budgets, storage and PHI rules.
collaborator: Site partners: data sharing, standards, intake, contacts.
